decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w10' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8689. Series context: trend strength 0.9894 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.212); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.731.
